Test Case ID: Scenario A - School Creation and Configuration

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login as admin; 2) Page "Trường" (/admin/schools); 3) Click "Tạo trường"; 4) Fill Name/Address/Phone/Email; 5) Click "Lưu"
Expected Results: School created; 201; status Active; stored with unique ID

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login admin; 2) At "Tạo trường" dùng tên đã tồn tại; 3) Submit
Expected Results: Either allowed per BR or shows validation "Tên trường đã tồn tại"; no duplicate if rule requires unique
Pre-conditions: Admin logged in; School with same name exists

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login as school_admin; 2) Page "Thông tin trường"; 3) Click "Chỉnh sửa"; 4) Update address/phone; 5) Click "Lưu"
Expected Results: Info updated; 200; immediately visible
Pre-conditions: School admin logged in; Assigned school

Test Case Description: School admin cannot view other school
Test Case Procedure: 1) Login schooladmin1 (School A); 2) Try URL with School B; 3) Observe
Expected Results: Access denied (403) or empty; isolation kept
Pre-conditions: Two schools exist; admin A belongs School A
